tickets.title: [Workstream F] agb review self-measures recall via adlc review-calibration
tickets.body:
handoff.md (this repo, root) is the authoritative design for this ticket. Read it in full before starting — do not re-derive the target integration model, gap analysis, or sequencing. Treat its numbered tasks and acceptance criteria as the contract; this ticket body summarizes and adds verification commands, it does not replace it. Implements handoff.md §5 Workstream F, task 6.

agb review (the read-only loop-until-dry lens fleet in lib/review.mjs) should periodically self-measure recall using adlc review-calibration — does the review fleet actually catch planted mutants? — closing the loop on booster's own reviewer quality the way hollow-test closes it for a single ticket's tests.

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA:
- AC1: lib/review.mjs gains a calibration mode that invokes adlc review-calibration against a mutant-seeded fixture and reports recall. VERIFY: a test stubs the CLI, asserts invocation with the review command template, and asserts the recall score is surfaced in the review run's output.
- AC2: Documented in docs/guidelines.md as an opt-in periodic check, not part of every agb review invocation (cost). VERIFY: grep for a "review-calibration" section noting opt-in behavior.
- AC3: npm test exits 0.
